subject: Interview invitation — Product Design Intern
body:
Hi Sam,

We really enjoyed reviewing your portfolio and would love to invite you to a first-round interview for the Product Design Intern role.

Please use the link below to pick a time that suits you. We have slots available Sunday and Monday next week.

Book here: https://canva.com/schedule/xyz

Looking forward to speaking,
Priya
Talent Team, Canva
